svg.title: Cloud Linux Hardening Lab — Trust Boundaries and Security Architecture
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing administrative access over Tailscale, blocked public SSH at UFW, hardened OpenSSH, host defense-in-depth controls, and Wazuh telemetry to the AWS Wazuh manager.
svg.text: Private administrative access over Tailscale, UFW interface enforcement, host hardening controls, and Wazuh observability

g.text: systemd: active • Streams auth, auditd, FIM & SCA telemetry

svg.text: Architectural Principle: OpenSSH remains on standard port 22; UFW interface filtering on tailscale0 enforces the administrative network boundary.
